communication: Sum of matched receive.download_complete_s - send.transfer_start_s, round events only. Client_Side_all_messages includes both directions between client and server, including operation RPC/control. Server_Side_all_messages includes both directions between server and keycenter. Client_Side_model_upload includes only client->server/encrypted_chunk. Each message counted once.
total: Train + Enc + HE_comp + Dec + Client_Side_all_messages + Server_Side_all_messages; excludes encoding, key generation, flatten, selection and other overhead. Not round wall time.
old_table: The exact communication message selection behind the user-provided older table has not been established.
source_run_note: source_run is the original run; source_runs_by_dataset records the current sources.
